No WSL distribution is attached or installed, no probe is executed, no update, repair, removal, or global reconfiguration happens, and no readiness is projected; runtime, provider, recovery, security, visual and performance proof remains NOT_RUN.

Virtualization is disabled in firmware; the platform state stays explicit until re-probed after enablement.

value.reason: Bounded repair (reinstall PM dependencies, re-run probes) needs explicit scope; reset, delete, and convert stay refused rows.
Even PM-owned image state is destroyed by reset, so the user confirms destructively first.

invalid.name: attach_claims_pm_managed_ownership
invalid.reason: An attached distro stays user-owned; claiming managed ownership would let PM update, repair, or remove someone else's system (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: attach_without_compat_probe_pass
invalid.reason: Attach admits only a compatible WSL2 distro, and compatibility is a probe pass, not a name match or an assumption (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: managed_install_without_image_proof
invalid.reason: A managed install admits only a signed versioned image; without Release proof there is no admission, only a blocked acquisition (CRAU-101, RSC-008).

invalid.name: managed_install_claims_signing_without_release_admission
invalid.rejects_for: Release admission receipt is required in addition to image signing metadata
invalid.reason: Caller-supplied hash, key and provenance fields do not prove Release admitted this exact .wsl image (CRAU-101, RSC-008).

invalid.name: managed_install_with_empty_signing_key
invalid.reason: An empty signing identity is not a signature; untrusted or half-described images fail closed instead of installing (CRAU-101, RSC-008).

invalid.name: probe_invents_an_assumed_status
invalid.reason: There is no assumed outcome: an unrun GPU probe reports unknown, never a filled-in available that would project Ready by assumption (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: drvfs_mount_claims_native_performance
invalid.rejects_for: mounts performance_class is an observed closed value, not a claim
invalid.reason: /mnt/c is not an equivalent high-performance Linux source root; a DrvFs observation cannot borrow the linux_native class (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: user_owned_reset_admitted
invalid.reason: Repair on a user-owned distro can never reset, delete, or convert it; the destructive confirmation that fits a managed distro does not transfer (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: global_shutdown_silently_allowed
invalid.reason: wsl --shutdown stops every distribution, so plain allowed would hide the blast radius the warning must name (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: wsl_off_marked_degraded
invalid.rejects_for: wsl_state off conditional requires health healthy
invalid.reason: WSL Off is healthy: flagging a supported off state as needing attention would turn a first-class native-Windows setup into a defect (CRAU-101).

invalid.name: silent_source_move_recorded
invalid.reason: A mapping exists only as an explicit record; a non-explicit row would be the silent source move the contract forbids (CRAU-101).
